title: Every phone message and Tally's reply shows in Tally's pane on the Mac, across fresh restarts

requirements.text: GenlockCore parses every [phone] prompt and the reply that answered it from all of the Assistant's transcripts, oldest first
Tally's pane on the Mac has a Phone thread showing those exchanges, including ones from before the last fresh restart
requirements.check: eye: relaunch, open Tally, open the Phone thread; the 20:14 and 20:31 status updates and the 20:17 walk answers all show with replies

requirements.text: The thread updates while open when a new phone message is answered
requirements.check: eye: send from the phone with the thread open; it appears without reopening

requirements.text: App builds and all tests pass
requirements.check: cd app && swift build && swift test

evidence: swift test --filter PhoneThread: 9 tests 0 failures (reply to end_turn, relay/laptop excluded, queued command, wrapped voice, items block cut, cached reader picks up later answer); real transcripts: 131 phone exchanges across 23 conversations, 123 replied, matching bridge log 20:14:54/20:17:35/20:31:29
swift build: Build complete; swift test: Executed 155 tests, 1 skipped, 0 failures

text: PhoneThread parser + cached Reader in GenlockCore; Phone button in Tally's pane header opens PhoneThreadView popover (reloads every 3s). Off-screen render with real data showed 133 exchanges incl. TJ's 3:45 PM message. Left: TJ eye reqs 2-3 after relaunch. Not committed.
